incident-bot: :rotating_light: URGENT: Elevated 5xx rates observed across prod-edge-gateway (us-west-2). Error pattern: TLS handshake failures + downstream 502/524. Paging on-call: @alice

alice (SRE-oncall): I see the page. Looking at gateway dashboards now.

alice (SRE-oncall): top-line: 5xx rate jumped from ~0.5% to ~22% at 15:07 UTC. Latency also spiking.

ben (eng-runtime): I pulled recent envoy metrics — a lot of "TLS handshake failed" logs and "no client cert provided" in mTLS validation.

carla (edge): Confirmed. Edge proxies are failing client auth during handshake. Appears starting at 15:06:48 UTC.

alice (SRE-oncall): Can someone run an openssl check against a few gateways?

ben (eng-runtime): Running quick check from my laptop:
```
openssl s_client -connect prod-gateway-usw2.redwood.com:443 -servername prod-gateway-usw2.redwood.com -showcerts
```
Output shows chain with intermediate cert expiring 2026-03-14 14:59:00 UTC.

carla (edge): Whoa. Intermediate cert expiry would cause handshake failures when clients or proxies verify the chain. That matches the "no valid chain" logs.

dan (eng-security): Which cert are we talking about? CA rotation yesterday didn't include the intermediate?

ben (eng-runtime): It looks like the intermediate in the chain we shipped to edge was the older intermediate (CN=Redwood Intermediate CA v1) and it expired today. The leaf cert is still valid.

alice (SRE-oncall): Impact: clients performing strict chain validation or mutual TLS will fail handshake. That explains the spike and 5xx for internal downstream services requiring mTLS.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0314-01 (severity: P1) — on-call engagement and exec notify.

alice (SRE-oncall): Immediate mitigation options: 1) Replace chain on gateway with new intermediate (hot swap). 2) Disable mandatory mTLS enforcement at gateway (accept connections without client cert) as temporary fallback. 3) Route traffic to fallback region/edge pool that has correct chain.

carla (edge): Hot-swapping intermediate cert on the fleet is safest, but will take time due to rollout and TTLs. Rolling restart of envoy might be required to pick up new chain.

ben (eng-runtime): I can trigger emergency cert push to the edge control plane. Preparing artifacts now.

dan (eng-security): We need to ensure the new intermediate is trusted by clients and that the new chain matches what we present to clients (no cross-signed mismatch). I'll validate footprints.

alice (SRE-oncall): Short-lived mitigation: switch gateway policy to `optional` client auth so downstream services can still talk. This reduces protection but restores availability. Do we need approval? Execs prefer minimal blast radius and fast recovery.

carla (edge): I can flip the auth mode on a small fraction of gateways for canary. Command (envoy config):
```
# example envoy snippet
filter_chains:
  - tls_context:
      common_tls_context:
        alpn_protocols: ["h2", "http/1.1"]
        validation_context:
          trusted_ca:
            filename: "/etc/ssl/certs/new_intermediate.pem"
      require_client_certificate: false  # temporary
```

alice (SRE-oncall): Carve out a canary: 5% of traffic -> disable mTLS enforcement there. If stable, expand.

ben (eng-runtime): Pushing new intermediate PEM to control plane now. Pushed to canary pool (gp-edge-canary-1).

carla (edge): Canary enabled at 15:23 UTC. Monitoring.

alice (SRE-oncall): Adding a quick smoke test: curl to canary node with client cert should succeed if chain accepted.

ben (eng-runtime): Smoke test: `curl --cert client.pem --key client.key https://gp-edge-canary-1.redwood.com/health` -> 200 OK.

carla (edge): Canary looks good; no TLS handshake failures in canary logs.

alice (SRE-oncall): Expanding rollout to 40% at 15:31 UTC. Monitoring metrics.

incident-bot: Executing preconfigured post-deploy checks.

eve (support): Any customer-facing impact? I have a few incoming tickets citing "API 502" and "connection reset".

alice (SRE-oncall): Yes: some customers hitting strict mTLS stacks experienced failures. We should notify CS with guidance: temporary disable strict client chain validation or use new intermediate when we announce rotation.

ben (eng-runtime): Full fleet rollout started at 15:35 UTC. We're streaming the new intermediate and rotating cert chains. Estimated full completion 15:50 UTC.

carla (edge): Rolling restart of envoy workers on each host to pick up chain. Doing staggered restarts to avoid capacity loss.

dan (eng-security): I've verified new intermediate fingerprint: SHA256: AB:CD:EF:12:34:56:78:90:... matches expected. Also created CRL/OCSP checks. No sign of compromise.

alice (SRE-oncall): Observability: 5xx rate down from 22% -> 1.2% by 15:42 UTC. Latency normalizing.

incident-bot: Pager duty auto-check: on-call handoff scheduled at 16:00 UTC. @frank will take next shift.

frank (oncall-next): Acknowledge. I'll take over at 16:00 and keep monitoring until postmortem action items are done.

eve (support): Updating affected customer threads: brief note that we identified an expired intermediate cert, rolled a fix, and to open a case if they still see errors. Will post a longer incident summary once we have more detail.

carla (edge): Fleet rollout complete at 15:48 UTC. All gateways serving the new chain. No further handshake errors seen in last 5 minutes.

alice (SRE-oncall): Mitigation summary: 1) Hot-rolled new intermediate cert to all gateways. 2) Temporary canary -> rollback path used. 3) mTLS enforcement toggled only for initial canary, not full disable in prod.

dan (eng-security): Action items: - Validate CA rotation automation to ensure intermediate updates are included in future pushes. - Add guardrail: alert if any certificate in active chain has expiry < 48h.

ben (eng-runtime): Action items: - Add automated post-rotate smoke tests (client+server) to cert push pipeline. - Ensure control-plane rejects chain with expired intermediates.

alice (SRE-oncall): Scheduling postmortem meeting: 2026-03-15 17:00 UTC. Invite SRE, eng-runtime, eng-edge, security, support.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0314-01 marked as "mitigated" at 15:49 UTC. Creating postmortem doc template.

alice (SRE-oncall): Final note: if anyone still sees TLS errors, ping me directly. Big thanks to everyone for quick response. :tada: 

frank (oncall-next): Logged rotation details and will inherit monitoring.

eve (support): Drafting customer communication now. Will link postmortem once ready.

carla (edge): Filed a follow-up ticket for cert pipeline work and added regression tests.

dan (eng-security): Closing loop: revocation/OCSP good. No evidence of attack. Root cause: expired intermediate in edge bundle due to missed staged rotation job.

alice (SRE-oncall): Closing thread; will add timeline & artifacts to the postmortem doc.
